correctness.rationale: The physical simplex is forward invariant. Exact polynomial identities factor F and F' and prove a unique triple root at C=1/4. An explicit coercive-on-the-simplex Lyapunov function has derivative <= -(8/3)v^2-(3/8)y^2-(125/1032)z^2; LaSalle gives global attraction. The Jacobian has eigenvalues 0, -1/3, and (-53±sqrt(265))/24. The cubic center invariance equations give u'=-384u^3/53+O(u^4); stable-fiber tracking implies the exact signed four-vector coefficient. Symbolic code checked all pivotal identities and numerical tests were supplementary.

value.rationale: At a natural balanced-demand cusp of an applied four-compartment congestion model, exact global stability coexists with nonexponential generic response. The computed four-coordinate physical t^-1/2 amplitude demonstrates a precise transient factor 53/12 that is absent from its equivalent scalar stationary equation; this answers a dynamical critical-slowing question left by qualitative equilibrium and hysteresis analysis. The finite exact parameter point is canonical because the cubic cusp conditions uniquely select the critical gamma and road capacity in the balanced family; it is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
